summary: This video details two top-performing team compositions against the Lv. 300 Tainted Guard boss in Crisis Rally Battle: a Toxin team and an Aura team. The creator breaks down the exact hero builds, artifact choices, skill timing rotations, and inspiration test results for Child of Chaos. The Toxin setup delivers over 7 billion damage, while the 5-DPS Aura setup achieves up to 8.9 billion damage.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Built with Angelic Alliance artifact, high attack, accuracy, and around 6 skill haste for smooth rotation synchronization.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.verdict: High-tier damage dealer in Toxin team
heroes.note: Requires exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst; increasing inspiration from level 2 to 5 increased overall team damage by roughly 1 billion.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Built with high attack and Misty Conch artifact to inflict Defense Penalty II.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Requires high attack bonus (+5.5k) and high enlightenment (+600) to maximize damage output.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.verdict: DPS and debuffer in Toxin team
heroes.note: Equipped with Puppeteer set and built with attack and accuracy.

heroes.name: Aemonleyda
heroes.verdict: Key survival tank for Aura team
heroes.note: Built pure tank with high HP/Defense and Golden Antlers artifact; operates on default auto timing without manual rotation setup.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Uses Puppeteer set to maximize shared attack bonus to team damage dealers.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.verdict: Attack buffer and Aura field trigger
heroes.note: Uses 2-piece Puppeteer and Vortex Illusion with first cast set to around 11.5s to 11.7s.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Built with over 90k HP and critical damage to output massive damage under Aura fields.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Equipped with Angelic Alliance, Wildsand Devotion, and Secrecy sets; left on default timing with high skill haste.

teams.note: Toxin team running a synchronized 17.2s recast rotation, outputting 6.2B to 7.0B+ damage per run.
Full Aura team operating on a 17.5s recast loop, achieving up to 8.9B total damage.

tips: Synchronize your team's recast skill timings (e.g., 17.2s for Toxin, 17.5s for Aura) so ultimate abilities line up with debuffs and buffs.
Equip attack-sharing heroes like Lincos and Diantha with Puppeteer set pieces to stack Attack % bonuses across the entire team.
Build Aemonleyda with high HP and Defense so she withstands boss crowd control and single-target attacks without needing skill timing delays.
title: CRUSHING THE TAINTED GUARD BOSS: Toxin & Aura Team Setups! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
